meta.description: Graphify vs no-Graphify token cost. For each question the graph answers in one compact query_graph call; the 'no graph' baseline is the source files that query's answer nodes come from - i.e. the code an agent would have to read to answer the same question. That baseline is generous to the no-graph side: it assumes the agent already knows exactly which files to open, which is itself what the graph provides. Regenerate query set as needed; ratios depend on the ORE checkout (ORE_ENGINE). s01-s08 are the original suite (kept unchanged for history); s09-s50 widen coverage to every merged chunk and vary mode/depth/phrasing, added to catch term-weight drift outside the trade-pricing core the original 8 focus on (see CLAUDE.md rule 3).
